items.summaryOriginal: South Korea will launch a 5 trillion won ($3.52 billion) semiconductor fund targeting promising chip materials, parts, equipment and fabless companies, ‌a presidential official said, as Seoul seeks to accelerate plans for new chip manufacturing hubs across the ‌country. The government will also provide a further 5 trillion won in trade finance for suppliers, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik told a press ​briefing after a meeting chaired by President Lee Jae Myung on Monday. The measures are part of Lee's semiconductor megaproject initiative unveiled in June, under which Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, together with suppliers and local governments, are expected to invest more than $576 billion in new chip manufacturing projects, including major fabrication facilities in the country's southwest region.

items.summary: SpaceX 주식은 주식 잠금 기간이 만료됨에 따라 금요일에 16% 급등하여 한 달 만에 최고치를 기록한 후 월요일 휴식을 취했습니다. 이 주식은 6월 12일 최초 공모 직후 도달한 6월 16일 최고치인 201.80달러를 마감한 이후 힘든 시간을 보냈습니다. 월스트리트는 목요일에 SpaceX의 첫 번째 잠금 만료로 인해 약 9억 1100만 개의 제한된 내부 주식이 해제되면서 극심한 매도 압력에 대비했습니다.
items.summaryOriginal: SpaceX stock took a break Monday after surging 16% on Friday to its highest close in a month as a lockup period for shares expired. The stock has had a torrid time since its closing high of $201.80 on June 16—reached shortly after its initial public offering on June 12. Wall Street had widely braced for severe selling pressure on Thursday, when SpaceX’s first lockup expiration freed roughly 911 million restricted insider shares.
